sources.name: flusight-target-hospital-admissions.csv
sources.pinning: file at a fixed commit of the hub (ae9b0627, 2026-10-07); the hub's main branch rewrites this file every week and revises earlier weeks
sources.license: MIT (cdcepi/FluSight-forecast-hub); the underlying counts are CDC NHSN data, a work of the U.S. Government
sources.citation: CDC Influenza Division and the FluSight hub contributors. FluSight forecast hub target data (weekly laboratory-confirmed influenza hospital admissions, NHSN Weekly Hospital Respiratory Data).
